summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. In the United States, Valsartan carries a boxed warning—the strongest warning level—for heart harm and injury or death to an unborn baby [3][7]. The drug label also warns to watch for low blood pressure, swelling, and changes in kidney function and potassium levels [7]. Additionally, one clinical study was stopped early due to safety concerns [9].
